system.name: Multimodal RewardBench 2 (MMRB2)
system.one_liner: A benchmark of 1,000 expert-annotated preference pairs per task for reward models judging text-to-image, editing, interleaved and reasoning outputs.

content.variant_note: four task cards, each a full preference record: prompt, candidates A and B, a human verdict and a GPT-judge verdict
content.argues: MMRB2 covers four demanding omni tasks, each with a real prompt, two candidate responses from strong models or agents, and human versus GPT-judge verdicts with reasons.
content.subject: Four task cards of benchmark examples: prompt, candidate outputs A and B, and human versus GPT verdicts.

lessons.what_to_learn: A uniform card anatomy (title, prompt with its input images, two captioned candidates, icon-led verdict lines) lets one figure cover four unlike task types and makes human and model judgments comparable. Elide long outputs with [...] and [IMAGE].
lessons.suits: Benchmarks or datasets with several task types built on pairwise comparisons, especially reward-model, preference and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations.

evidence: Each subtask contains 1,000 expert-annotated preference pairs, consisting of a task prompt, a preferred response, and a rejected response.
Examples of multimodal preference pairs in MMRB2 across four subtasks: text-to-image generation, interleaved generation, image editing, and multimodal reasoning

summary: Multimodal RewardBench 2 (MMRB2) is a benchmark for reward models of omni models that read and write interleaved text and images, with 1,000 expert-annotated preference pairs for each of four tasks. Figure 1 is a gallery of four tinted cards, one per task: text-to-image, image editing, interleaved generation and multimodal reasoning. Every card has the same anatomy: a title, the prompt with its input photos where the task has them, two candidate responses (A and B) captioned with the generating model or agent, and below them one verdict line from a human expert and one from a GPT judge, each led by an icon. Long outputs are shortened with [...] and [IMAGE]. Flat pink and blue cards, typewriter text, no arrows.
summary_zh: MMRB2 是面向图文交错全模态模型的奖励模型基准，每个任务含 1000 对专家标注偏好对。图 1 用四张淡色卡片展示文生图、图像编辑、交错生成和多模态推理，各含提示、A/B 候选输出及人类与 GPT 评审结论。
notes: Prior labels kept (scope-overview, side-by-side-contrast, example-gallery). Pictures counted as 13 placed images. The human and GPT verdicts disagree in the first two cards and agree in the last two; this is read from the text, the figure does not mark it. The 4 pt text is read from the digest. Human icon is a bitmap and the OpenAI logo is vector, inferred from the digest's picture list (four 11x11 pt bitmaps).
